scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @nest-native/sqs && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:cov: c8 --all --include "packages/sqs/**/*.ts" --exclude "packages/sqs/test/**" --exclude "packages/sqs/interfaces.ts" --exclude "packages/sqs/index.ts" --exclude "packages/sqs/testing/index.ts" --exclude "**/*.d.ts" --exclude "**/dist/**" --reporter text --reporter text-summary --reporter json-summary --reporter lcov --check-coverage --branches 100 --functions 100 --lines 100 --statements 100 npm run test:report
scripts.release:check: npm run release:check:readme-links && npm run release:check:readme-version && npm run release:check:nestjs-resolution && npm run release:check:pack
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test:cov && npm run complexity:check && npm run complexity:report && npm run release:check && npm run security:audit
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d && node scripts/wait-for-sqs.mjs http://127.0.0.1:19324
scripts.test:full: npm run test && SQS_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:19324 SQS_PAUSE_CONTAINER=nest-sqs-elasticmq npm run test:integration:strict
